topic: NP modifiers denoting time and place
claim: Modifiers with NP form are limited to those denoting age, size and similar properties, or non-referential distributive indefinites.
evidence_summary: The same display [13i] includes the results last year and houses this side of the lake, which locate the referent in time or space.
finding: Extend the list to temporal and spatial location, or say how similar properties covers them. CX-20 treats the same examples as a construction family.
proposed_wording: limited to those denoting age, size, location in time or space and similar properties, or non-referential distributive indefinites
inference: Do the listed meanings cover the NP modifiers in [13i]?

evidence.establishes: The stated limit excludes half of [13i].
